messages:
talia: Ok team — starting intake for onboarding ORION-9b (quant-int8) across hosted / dedicated / private. Need a short rollout checklist and canary plan. Main concerns: quality regressions vs fp16, tail latency, and fallback behavior.

sam: +1. We should lock the eval suite and the rollback thresholds before any traffic. p95 and p99 latency, token cost delta, and automatic quality regression detectors.

devin: Draft checklist (quick):
- smoke tests (generation + embed sanity)
- local quant perf + memory check
- canary infra: 1% -> 5% -> 20% ramp
- fallback mapping: ORION-9b-fp16 (primary fallback), ORION-lite (graceful degrade)
- auto-rollover triggers (errors > 1%, p99 > 3s, quality drop > 2 pts)

marta: Ops notes:
- Dedicated: reserve 2 extra GPUs for canary bursts, pin Q model to same kernel set
- Private: ensure KMS key onboarding and egress rules in VPC config
- Warmup: prefix cache priming script (see snippet)

marta: ```bash
# prime KV cache on hosts
curl -X POST $HOST/api/prime -d '{"prompts": ["hi","summarize: ..."]}'
```

ci-bot: CI: orion-9b-int8 build passed (tests: 124/124), quant smoke: OK.

talia: Thanks. For rollouts: propose windows and automatic rollback rules:
- Window: 02:00-08:00 UTC (low-traffic) for initial 1% and 5% ramps
- Ramps: 1% (2h) -> 5% (3h) -> 20% (6h) -> full (conditional)
- Rollback if any of: error_rate > 0.8% for 15m, p99 latency increases > 30% vs baseline, eval-suite fail rate > 1.5%

devin: Eval harness details: split prompts into categories (chat, code, summarization, multi-turn). Run nightly batch with baseline fp16 and diff metrics. Example runner:
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model orion-9b-int8 --suite suites/orion_core.json --out /tmp/int8_eval.json
```
Compare: `jq .metrics /tmp/int8_eval.json` and trigger alert if delta > thresholds.

sam: Also add production monitors: token-per-request distribution, unexpected sampling drops, and hallucination proxy metrics (QPS of safety filters). We'll route alerts to #eng-oncall and create a short dashboard tile for quick triage.

marta: Private deployment extra: schedule an ops window with customer for cache-warm and fallback verification. Need CA signed certs and policy for model artifacts.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly canary window is Tue 06:00 UTC. Notify oncall 1h prior.

talia: Action items:
- devin: finalize eval suite + thresholds (ETA: today EOD)
- sam: dashboard tiles + alert rules (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- marta: infra prep (dedicated extra GPUs + private onboarding checklist) (ETA: 48h)
- all: ack here when you own the item

sam: acked (dashboard + alerts)

devin: acked (eval suite PR open)

marta: acked (infra tickets created: DED-472, PRIV-523)

talia: Great. Once all items are green we'll schedule the first 1% canary. Keeping fallback policy strict. If anyone wants to add silent metrics to the canary (e.g., token entropy), shout now. :thumbsup:
